comment: Synthesized AIDCS Function Registry for Dashboard, AdminDashboard, and Login

actions.name: login_user
actions.description: Submits user credentials to authenticate against the system

actions.name: navigate_to_route
actions.description: Triggers the router to change pages (e.g., to /dashboard or /admin)

actions.name: toggle_theme
actions.description: Switch between light and dark mode

actions.name: export_metrics_report
actions.description: Download or save the current dashboard metrics as a file

actions.name: read_chart_data
actions.description: Extract data points from the main display chart

actions.name: view_user_details
actions.description: Open a modal or navigate to a specific user's details profile

actions.name: delete_user
actions.description: Remove a user from the system via the admin panel

actions.name: update_global_settings
actions.description: Save changes made in the admin settings panel

actions.name: read_system_logs
actions.description: Read the recent system exceptions or logs from the admin dashboard

actions.name: display_chat_message
actions.description: Show feedback or queries from the AI assistant
